subject: countTokens billing treatment for the Gemini API surface used by certified scan-identify v140
findings: The Gemini API reference confirms countTokens accepts a complete GenerateContentRequest, including system instructions and function declarations, so the exact paid-request shape can be counted.
The token guide states that a text-and-image request returns the combined input count, and that actual post-generation usage is reported through usageMetadata.
The Gemini API documentation reviewed does NOT explicitly state that countTokens is non-billable.

surfaceConfusionToAvoid.claim: A Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform page states its Count Tokens API has no charge and no quota restriction.
surfaceConfusionToAvoid.why_it_does_not_apply: That is a different service surface from the Gemini API key used by certified v140. A no-charge statement for one surface must not be transferred to another; doing so would understate the ceiling on the surface actually being billed.
surfaceConfusionToAvoid.ruling: Do not treat countTokens as confirmed free on the basis of the Enterprise Agent Platform page.

verification.verifiedBy: project owner review, relayed to the agent 2026-07-30
verification.note: The evaluation agent has no web access in this session and did not independently retrieve the official documentation. This record reflects the owner's review and must be re-verified against the live source immediately before the first countTokens request.

consequences: COUNTTOKENS BILLING MODE is reported as NOT EXPLICITLY DOCUMENTED, never as confirmed free.
countTokens request counts are recorded separately from generation attempts.
Any verified countTokens charge enters cumulative spend rather than being assumed zero. ReservationLedger takes countTokensBillable as an explicit parameter for exactly this reason.
After the smoke, actual project billing or usage evidence must be checked; if unexpected preflight charges appear, stop before the development baseline.
reverificationRequired: immediately before the first countTokens request of any paid run
